title: iOS .NET game created with brackets in `dotnet/project/assembly_name` creates invalid Info.plist file
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in:  4.7.2.stable, 4.5.2-stable, 4.6.3-stable

### System information

macOS 15.7.3 (24G419), Apple M1 (Virtual), 4 threads, arm64 - 4.7.2.stable.mono.official [ed1daf0bf]  (official .NET build), Xcode 26.41, .NET SDK 9.0.101

### Issue description

When exporting a .NET game for iOS which has a bracket character in the name "e.g. Squash the Creeps (3D)" the export creates an `Info.plist` file with invalid characters:

```bash
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine squash_the_creeps_90121 % plutil -p "out/output/dylibs/ExportRelease/Squash the Creeps (3D)_aot.xcframework/ios-arm64/Squash the Creeps (3D).framework/Info.plist"
{
  "CFBundleExecutable" => "Squash the Creeps (3D)"
  "CFBundleIdentifier" => "com.shipthis.mono.testflight.framework.Squash-the-Creeps--3D-"
  "CFBundleInfoDictionaryVersion" => "6.0"
  "CFBundleName" => "Squash the Creeps (3D)"
  "CFBundlePackageType" => "FMWK"
  "CFBundleShortVersionString" => "1.0"
  "CFBundleVersion" => "1"
  "DTPlatformName" => "iphoneos"
  "MinimumOSVersion" => "15.0"
}
```

When the IPA is uploaded via `altool` we get the following validation error:

```bash
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine out % xcrun altool --validate-app -t ios -f ipa/*.ipa \
  --apiKey XXXXX --apiIssuer XXXXXXX

Running altool at path '/Applications/Xcode_26.4.1.app/Contents/SharedFrameworks/ContentDelivery.framework/Resources/altool'...

2026-09-06 13:46:04.292 ERROR: [ContentDelivery.Uploader.600003A4E500] 
=======================================
VERIFY FAILED with 1 error, 1 warning
=======================================
Failed to validate package.
2026-09-06 13:46:04.296 ERROR: [altool.600003A4E500] Invalid Info.plist value. The CFBundleExecutable Info.plist key contains the Squash the Creeps (3D) value in the “Payload/output.app/Frameworks/Squash the Creeps (3D).framework” bundle. This key’s value can’t contain any of the following unsupported characters: \ [ ] { } ( ) + * (90121) The server’s response was: ‘{
    code = 90121;
    description = "Invalid Info.plist value. The CFBundleExecutable Info.plist key contains the Squash the Creeps (3D) value in the \U201cPayload/output.app/Frameworks/Squash the Creeps (3D).framework\U201d bundle. This key\U2019s value can\U2019t contain any of the following unsupported characters: \\ [ ] { } ( ) + *";
}’.
   NSUnderlyingError : A server error occurred. (-19241)
      code : 90121
      description : Invalid Info.plist value. The CFBundleExecutable Info.plist key contains the Squash the Creeps (3D) value in the “Payload/output.app/Frameworks/Squash the Creeps (3D).framework” bundle. This key’s value can’t contain any of the following unsupported characters: \ [ ] { } ( ) + *
   iris-code : 90121

2026-09-06 13:46:04.299 ERROR: [altool.600003A4C440] ExitFailure (31)
```


### Steps to reproduce

This can be recreated with the official example [Squash the Creeps](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/mono/squash_the_creeps) - but you will need to enable the `textures/vram_compression/import_etc2_astc` setting and setup the export presets with valid credentials.

Export:

```bash
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine ipabuild % unzip -q ~/squash_the_creeps_90121_v2.zip
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine ipabuild % cd squash_the_creeps_90121 
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine squash_the_creeps_90121 % cp ~/export_presets.signed.cfg export_presets.cfg
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine squash_the_creeps_90121 % export GODOT=~/godot-stock/godot-4.7.2.mono-sc/Godot_mono.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine squash_the_creeps_90121 % "$GODOT" --headless --path . --build-solutions --quit
Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.mono.official.ed1daf0bf - https://godotengine.org
...trimmed...
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine squash_the_creeps_90121 % "$GODOT" --headless --path . --export-release iOS
Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.mono.official.ed1daf0bf - https://godotengine.org
...trimmed...
```

Build:

```bash
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine squash_the_creeps_90121 % cd out                                           
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine out % xcodebuild -project output.xcodeproj -scheme output -configuration Release \
  -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath output.xcarchive archive \
  DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=<DEV_TEAM_ID> CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual \
  CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="Apple Distribution" \
  PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=<PROFILE_UUID>
Command line invocation:
    /Applications/Xcode_26.4.1.app/Contents/Developer/usr/bin/xcodebuild -project output.xcodeproj -scheme output -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath output.xcarchive archive DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=<DEV_TEAM_ID> CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual "CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=Apple Distribution" PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=<PROFILE_UUID>
...trimmed...
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine out % 
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine out % xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath output.xcarchive \
  -exportOptionsPlist ~/ExportOptions.plist -exportPath ipa

2026-09-06 13:44:49.218 xcodebuild[45111:109027] [MT] IDEDistribution: -[IDEDistributionLogging _createLoggingBundleAtPath:]: Created bundle at path "/var/folders/hm/d7rr9ds96qx995ns72ry9g4m0000gn/T/output_2026-09-06_13-44-49.216.xcdistributionlogs".
Exported output to: /Users/admin/ipabuild/squash_the_creeps_90121/out/ipa
** EXPORT SUCCEEDED **
```

Validate:

```bash
admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine out % export API_PRIVATE_KEYS_DIR=~/private_keys

admin@Manageds-Virtual-Machine out % xcrun altool --validate-app -t ios -f ipa/*.ipa \
  --apiKey XXXXX --apiIssuer XXXX-XXXX-XX-XX-XXX

Running altool at path '/Applications/Xcode_26.4.1.app/Contents/SharedFrameworks/ContentDelivery.framework/Resources/altool'...

=======================================
VERIFY FAILED with 1 error, 1 warning
=======================================
Failed to validate package.
2026-09-06 13:46:04.296 ERROR: [altool.600003A4E500] Invalid Info.plist value. The CFBundleExecutable Info.plist key contains the Squash the Creeps (3D) value in the “Payload/output.app/Frameworks/Squash the Creeps (3D).framework” bundle. This key’s value can’t contain any of the following unsupported characters: \ [ ] { } ( ) + * (90121) The server’s response was: ‘{
    code = 90121;
    description = "Invalid Info.plist value. The CFBundleExecutable Info.plist key contains the Squash the Creeps (3D) value in the \U201cPayload/output.app/Frameworks/Squash the Creeps (3D).framework\U201d bundle. This key\U2019s value can\U2019t contain any of the following unsupported characters: \\ [ ] { } ( ) + *";
}’.
   NSUnderlyingError : A server error occurred. (-19241)
      code : 90121
      description : Invalid Info.plist value. The CFBundleExecutable Info.plist key contains the Squash the Creeps (3D) value in the “Payload/output.app/Frameworks/Squash the Creeps (3D).framework” bundle. This key’s value can’t contain any of the following unsupported characters: \ [ ] { } ( ) + *
   iris-code : 90121

2026-09-06 13:46:04.299 ERROR: [altool.600003A4C440] ExitFailure (31)
```

[squash_the_creeps_90121.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31881216/squash_the_creeps_90121.zip)
